content.text: Waking at 2am isn't unusual at 8. It often comes with school stress, a busy head, or a bedtime that's drifted. Tonight, try a 10-minute wind-down chat before lights out, where she can park any worries. If she still wakes, keep it calm and boring: walk her back to bed, lights low, no screens and no long talk. If it keeps going for weeks or she seems unwell, mention it to her doctor.
